678-5865-7272.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent has lost life this turn
You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
678-5865-7272.description:
Cast Flamecache Gecko by paying its mana cost.
When Flamecache Gecko enters, it triggers, adding {B}{R}.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Flamecache Gecko.
When Flamecache Gecko dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Flamecache Gecko from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

339-677-6965-8250.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

997-2445-5254.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
997-2445-5254.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat.

141-1070-8095.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1070-8095.description:
Cast Rise Again by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Rise Again.
Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Rise Again
Resolve the Rise Again copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

628-6972-8095.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken non-Human creature with base toughness 2 or greater.
628-6972-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another nontoken non-Human creature
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Hammerhead abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
628-6972-8095.notes: If the creature being used starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

4247-4871-5220-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
4247-4871-5220-6650.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4247-4871-5220-6650.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

240-4359-5470-6495.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat from step 2.
240-4359-5470-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

254-8095--5.description:
Cast First Day of Class by paying {1}{R}, creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, First Day of Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat

1981-2415-3967-5789.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3967-5789.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2239-4377-7370.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Ardent Elementalist.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Ardent Elementalist from exile to the battlefield.
When Ardent Elementalist enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

4496-5220-6772-6900.description:
Cast Accursed Centaur by paying its mana cost.
Activate Accursed Centaur by sacrificing it.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Syr Vondam trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain at least 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on them.
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3378-3821-4863.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}.
3378-3821-4863.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying {3}{U}, blinking Revolutionist and Peregrine Drake and causing you to draw a card.
When Revolutionist and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Illusionist's Stratagem to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
3378-3821-4863.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

2816-7070-7444.description:
Activate Umbral Mantle's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Umbral Mantle ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Advanced Reconstruction.
Repeat.

1445-1913-4871-6798.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and an artifact creature card in your graveyard.
1445-1913-4871-6798.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Imotekh the Stormlord triggers if the creature that was returned to your hand was an artifact, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

240-4050-5470-7060.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding one mana of any color
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

141-2510-7101.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
141-2510-7101.description:
Cast Airbending Lesson by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost reduced by Semblance Anvil.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Airbending Lesson targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve Airbending Lesson, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {0} due to Semblance Anvil.
Repeat from step 3.

775-1409-3129.description:
Activate Jewel Thief by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Jewel Thief enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Jewel Thief.
Resolve the Jewel Thief trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

483-2034-4681-5170.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Cruel Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

567-2919-3490-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
567-2919-3490-5231.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

104-2999-3490-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-2999-3490-4050.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1170-1329-1492-3464.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1170-1329-1492-3464.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Welding Jar.
Cast Welding Jar from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Hyrax Tower Scout.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1651-3263-5640-6859.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping it and Servant of Tymaret, targeting Servant of Tymaret.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying Clock of Omens' ability, targeting Clock of Omens.
Resolve both Clock of Omens  abilities, untapping it and Servant of Tymaret.
Servant of Tymaret triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain that much life.
Repeat.

1409-2724-3080-4608.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U}{U} the first turn with {1}{U} each extra turn
1409-2724-3080-4608.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four enchantments.
1409-2724-3080-4608.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Exchange of Words trigger, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and Exchange of Words.
Activate Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Exchange of Words leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering the second ability it gained from Wormfang Manta's textbox as well as its own ability and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the first Exchange of Words trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the second Exchange of Words trigger, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Exchange of Words.
Repeat from step 5 during each turn.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2438-2770-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Donate.
2438-2770-5434-5555.description:
Cast Donate by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 2.

225-880-3703.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
225-880-3703.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Sporemound and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Sporemound trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land you control.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2921-4871-5544-6011.notablePrerequisites: Scavenger's Talent is at least level 2.
2921-4871-5544-6011.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Forsaken Miner.
When Forsaken Miner dies, Scavenger's Talent's second ability triggers, targeting an opponent, and Pitiless Plunderer triggers.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Scavenger's Talent trigger, causing an opponent to mill two cards.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

989-2825-4067-5126.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause an opponent to discard a card.
You have at least one additional card in hand.
You control at least one mana-producing permanent.
Elite Arcanist does not have summoning sickness.
989-2825-4067-5126.description:
Cause an opponent to discard at least one card.
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind over Matter twice by discarding Verdant Eidolon and another card, untapping Elite Arcanist and the mana-producing permanent.
Activate Elite Arcanist by paying {1} and tapping it, casting a copy of Dream Salvage without paying its mana cost.
Verdant Eidolon triggers, returning itself to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve Dream Salvage, causing you to draw at least one card.
Repeat from step 2.

396-942-2281-4050.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Samwise.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Samwise, adding {G}.
When Samwise dies, Saffi triggers, returning Samwise from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Samwise enters the battlefield, it and Blessed Sanctuary trigger.
Resolve the Blessed Sanctuary trigger, creating a 2/2 Unicorn creature token.
Resolve the Samwise trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Unicorn, adding {W}.
Cast Saffi by paying {G}{W}.
When Saffi enters the battlefield, Blessed Sanctuary triggers, creating a 2/2 Unicorn creature token.
Repeat.

1563-2486-3490-5295.notablePrerequisites:
Your commander on the battlefield under your control.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
1563-2486-3490-5295.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
The Servo enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to the ability granted by Master Chef, triggering Animation Module.
Holding priority, activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

1636-3490-4870-5268.notablePrerequisites:
Veteran of the Depths does not have summoning sickness.
Utopia Vow attached to Veteran of the Depths.
1636-3490-4870-5268.description:
Activate Veteran of the Depths by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Veteran of the Depths triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1283-1999-2499-4404.notablePrerequisites: Master Transmuter does not have summoning sickness.
1283-1999-2499-4404.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {1}, tapping it and returning Corridor Monitor to your hand, putting Corridor Monitor from your hand onto the battlefield.
Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve the first Corridor Monitor trigger, untapping Master Transmuter.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {1}, tapping it and returning Chromatic Orrery to your hand, putting Chromatic Orrery from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the remaining Corridor Monitor trigger from step 3, untapping Master Transmuter.
Repeat.

501-586-2170-2232.description:
Cast Priest of Gix by paying {B}.
Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve Cloudstone Curio's ability, returning Kalastria Healer from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Priest of Gix ability, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Kalastria Healer by paying {B}.
Kalastria Healer enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve Kalastria Healer's ability, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Cloudstone Curio's ability, returning Priest of Gix from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3062-4772-5115.description:
Activate Gemstone Array's first ability by paying {2}, putting four charge counters on it.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability twice by removing two charge counters from it, adding {2}.
Repeat.
